resume.description: I went to Norman Henshilwood High School and studied Computer Applications and Technology, Physical Science, Pure Mathematics and Business Studies. I then matriculated in 2022.
I did a 6 month online course at HyperionDev where I learned HTML, CSS, Javascript and Bootstrap.

A Bootcamp program that provides you with the core fundamentals of Web Development, learning coding languages such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MySQL, Node.js and more coding techniques. We being taught interpersonal and self-development skills to take us further in life.

projects.name: Zoom Eats
projects.description: A growing fast-food chain is looking to modernise its ordering process by developing a mobile application. The app aims to streamline the ordering experience for customers, reduce waiting times, and increase overall customer satisfaction. My team has done the designing and planning the development of this mobile application using SCRUM methodology, as well as developing a brand identity for the fast-food chain using UI/UX design and Figma in a 1 week timeframe.
